set_language: Gentle Georgian Gloucestershire, 1770s-1790s: soft green hills and hedgerows, stone cottages with shutters, a timber dairy byre with wooden pails, Jenner's panelled study in Berkeley with a garden window, a Soho hand-press shop in 1798; painted-parchment maps and globe; an 1881 Victorian lecture theatre and a plain 1980 assembly hall. One brown-and-white cow (the same cow every time).
explorer_lock: NONE this part (STUDIO_PLAYBOOK §3: never in the first minute).
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; sores, pus, rashes, blood, wounds or needles in skin (cowpox and smallpox are never shown as marks beyond two or three soft healed round marks on a hand); plague imagery (crosses on doors, carts of bodies, sick people); readable text, numbers or logos baked into the plate (VACCA, VACCINE, dates, the case-book, the Inquiry title page, headlines and board text are overlays in the edit); garbled writing; unfinished flat cards; unfinished Explorer hair; twin Explorer; Explorer at a Short's frame 0; a flame, lamp or glow on a Fast plate; a gavel (P7); Pasteur in a skullcap at the lectern (P5). motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns. A reuse row cuts a different window of a KEEP clip; never a still.
